name: tk
description: tk's own plugins, installed from a clone of this repository: claude plugin marketplace add /abs/path/tk, then claude plugin install tk@tk. Added by integration w1 so the plugin id is tk@tk, as packages/tk-claude-plugin/managed-settings.fragment.json expects.

plugins.name: tk
plugins.description: tk policy gate for Claude Code: PreToolUse checks every tool call against ~/.tk/policy.json and blocks when the hook fails; PostToolUse redacts and records.
